Article 10 — Dividends

1. Dividends paid by a company which is a resident of a Contracting State to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

2. However, such dividends may be taxed in the Contracting State of which the company paying the dividends is a resident, and according to the law of that State, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the dividends, the tax so charged shall not exceed 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends.

The treaty also contains the conditions reflected in the current verified rule set for the reduced dividend treatment. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.

Article 11 — Interest

1. Interest arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State may be taxed in that other State.

2. However, such interest may be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner of the interest, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the amount of the interest.

3. Certain qualifying commercial, inter-bank and bank-deposit interest is taxable only in the Contracting State in which the recipient is resident. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.

Article 12 — Royalties

1. Royalties arising in a Contracting State and paid to a resident of the other Contracting State shall be taxable only in that other State if such resident is the beneficial owner of the royalties.

2. Royalties referred to in paragraph 3(b) may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise, but if the recipient is the beneficial owner, the tax so charged shall not exceed 5 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

Paragraph 3 distinguishes copyright royalties from patent, trademark, design/model, plan, secret formula/process, equipment and know-how royalties. This English text is the UN Treaty Series translation; the authentic treaty texts control.
